head: bfd28a7de449eda601d879ed7f2ea7eb798550d6
conclusion: The mate turn now owns its 120 s deadline. It aborts the provider, kills the harness process group, and stops waiting 5 s later even if the provider ignores the abort. A timed-out turn saves one took-too-long notice in the thread, keeps proposals from completed tool calls (confirmable), releases the team queue so the next message is answered, and late output is fenced out. In the journey the notice appeared at ~125.5 s on desktop and phone.
changes: mate.ts: outer deadline race (settleBy + MATE_ABORT_GRACE_MS 5 s) around provider calls and channel revalidation; abort signal passed to the subscription runner
exec.ts run(): new signal option kills the process group like the timeout; subscription-chat.ts passes it
store.ts: timed-out finalize and the stale sweep save the notice and promote validated drafts in one write; mateTimeoutNotice and mateTurnKeepsProposals
mate-doors.ts and chat-actions.ts: cards kept by a timeout or crash can be confirmed; every other failure still deletes its drafts
serve.ts: no extra one-off warning when the notice is saved. React chat JSON no longer repeats a card under the person's own message (existing bug on every turn)
team-runtime.ts and team-leads.ts: no repeated error on the team message; docs/mate-arc.md finding 4 now records the narrow exception
verification: vitest: mate, mate-doors, subscription-chat, team-runtime (new), serve.*, browser/*, exec, chat-actions, telegram-mate, migration-v35 and others: all pass
subscription-chat test: aborting kills and reaps a real sh child and its sleep grandchild
Headless Chromium journey (evidence/lead-stall/journey.mjs, synthetic stub that proposes then hangs and ignores abort), 1440x900 and 390x844: 22 checks pass
followUps: Telegram, Slack and Discord still send only the failure text; they do not send cards kept by a timed-out turn
A team message that timed out keeps its existing Could not finish badge beside the lead notice
Desktop card buttons are 28 px tall (existing size, unchanged); phone buttons are 44 px
Not reproduced on a swap-starved machine or with a real claude or codex harness; the root cause in run 2438 is inferred, not observed
With direct API keys, a timeout still pauses chat until the unknown cost is confirmed (existing safety rule, unchanged)
